default.description: Default capabilities for Stalagmight. These grant the Tauri plugin commands the webview may call (the frontend uses only fs exists and writeTextFile); they do NOT bound the app's own commands, which take any path the webview sends. The trust boundary is that only the bundled frontend runs in the webview (strict CSP, script-src 'self'); the commands that write, replace or delete a file check its path first (src-tauri/src/commands/write_path.rs). See docs/architecture.md, IPC trust boundary.
